transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm just having trouble... keeping my mind on things. I can't stay focused on a task long enough to actually finish it. Even when it's important. 

Like at work, I'll start tracing a client's network problem, and... I don't know, ten minutes later I'll realize I've just been rereading the same log entries three times. And I still don't know what they say. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you had trouble staying focused like this since you were a child?

I suppose. Um... my mother actually still jokes about it. She says my old grade school report cards always said I was bright, but... I guess I never stayed in my seat. Or I'd blurt out answers. And... I was always losing my homework. Even when I had actually done it. So... yes. It's been a long time.
Do you often feel restless, like you need to be moving even when you’re supposed to sit still?

Yeah, I guess so. It's... hard to explain. Even when I'm supposed to just sit still and listen, it feels like... like there's a motor humming under my skin. I just get this urge that I need to stand up, or go check something, or just move on to the next problem right that second.
Do you have the same trouble focusing outside of work, like at home or in conversations?

I guess so. Um... yeah, I suppose it happens at home too. Sometimes my wife says I'm not listening to her, or... I'll start a project in the garage and just leave it sitting there. It's... just hard to keep track of things.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I worry any more than anyone else does.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No. Um... I don't think so. I mean, I get frustrated with things sometimes, but... no, I wouldn't say I feel depressed.
